improvementRules.description: Agent 05 test case design: Prevent premature actions in component state verification. Assert initial element state (e.g. loginButton is enabled on load) before performing actions/submissions.
improvementRules.suggestion: When verifying component state (e.g. button enabled/disabled, input masking), explicitly assert initial state on page load before performing interactions. Do not call composite actions like login() before checking the initial state.

improvementRules.description: Agent 05 assertion integrity: Mandate Playwright web-first assertions (e.g. await expect(locator).toBeVisible()). NEVER evaluate booleans via isVisible()/isEnabled() with .toBe(true) or broken .toContain(true).
improvementRules.suggestion: Always assert element state directly using await expect(locator).toBeVisible() or .toBeEnabled(). Web-first assertions provide auto-waiting and eliminate non-iterable type errors.

improvementRules.description: Agent 05 concurrency simulation: For test cases verifying concurrency or multi-session operations, spawn multiple browser.newContext() instances and execute via Promise.all instead of fake single-session sequential runs.
improvementRules.suggestion: Use browser.newContext() to create parallel isolated user sessions, execute login/actions concurrently with Promise.all, and properly close contexts.

improvementRules.description: Agent 05 Windows path safety: Sanitize testInfo.title with .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_') before constructing screenshot or artifact file paths to avoid illegal character ENOENT errors on Windows.
improvementRules.suggestion: Replace colons and special characters in test titles when saving failure attachments on Windows.

improvementRules.description: Agent 05 security & protocol tests: For test cases verifying encryption or protocols (e.g. TLS 1.2+, HTTPS, CSRF, Secure cookies), directly assert security details, headers, or cookies instead of generating generic UI login boilerplate.
improvementRules.suggestion: Verify response.securityDetails().protocol matches /TLS 1\.[23]/, assert response.url() starts with https://, and inspect headers/cookies directly.

improvementRules.description: Agent 05 test case specificity: Strictly forbid boilerplate login fallback for specialized acceptance criteria (e.g. WCAG accessibility, CSRF tokens, concurrency, responsiveness). Every test must directly assert its specific requirement.
improvementRules.suggestion: Do not copy-paste standard login flows into tests for accessibility, tokens, or security. Generate criteria-specific assertions.

improvementRules.description: Agent 05 recurring issue (×2): Negative or Edge test "[US-02] [NEG] Login Form Input Validation and UI Compliance — Use expired session token" asserts successful inventory visibility instead of an error state. Auto-patching to errorMessage assertion.
improvementRules.suggestion: Assert that errorMessage is visible or that error text matches expected validation, not inventoryContainer.toBeVisible().

improvementRules.description: Agent 05 recurring issue (×5): Race condition and incomplete session invalidation in TC-007: `page.context().clearCookies()` is executed immediately after `featurePage.loginButton.click()` without awaiting authentication completion and navigation to `/inventory.html`. Additionally, Swag Labs stores user session tokens in `sessionStorage` rather than solely in cookies, so clearing cookies alone does not simulate session termination.
improvementRules.suggestion: Await successful login and inventory page load (`await expect(page).toHaveURL(/.*inventory\.html/)`) prior to invalidating the session. Clear both cookies and browser storage using `await page.context().clearCookies()` and `await page.evaluate(() => sessionStorage.clear())`.
